label: FP16 / BF16
notes: Full 16-bit floating point baseline; compute-heavy and highest VRAM footprint.

label: Q8_0 (GGUF / 8-bit)
notes: Virtually indistinguishable from FP16; halves weight memory and doubles decode speed.

label: Q6_K (GGUF K-Quant)
notes: Sweet spot for 24B-32B coding and reasoning models when VRAM allows.

label: Q5_K_M (GGUF K-Quant)
notes: Strong balance between reasoning retention and bandwidth savings.

label: Q4_K_M (GGUF Default)
notes: Industry standard 4-bit K-quant with mixed Q6_K/Q5_K attention & output tensors.

label: MLX 4-bit (Affine Group-64)
notes: Native Apple Metal 4-bit affine quantization with minimal block metadata overhead.

label: IQ4_XS (Importance-Weighted)
notes: Importance-matrix quantized 4-bit format that trims ~12% weight memory vs Q4_K_M.

label: Q3_K_M (GGUF 3-bit)
notes: Useful for fitting 70B+ models into 48GB systems; noticeable degradation on small dense models.
